{{Otheruses|Tibanna}}
'''[[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]]-six''' was a highly flammable substance used as early as the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

During the [[Essien landing]], after Dorjander Kace suggested sending ground troops to take out the enemy forces, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dallan Morvis]] realized they had a lot of Tibanna-six and thus ordered the [[Phaeda Militia]] to burn down the [[forest]] instead, much to [[Zayne Carrick]]'s criticism.
